seo.title: About — Vikoma Group
seo.description: Vikoma Group connects Italian manufacturers with the Belarusian market: two languages, two regulatory systems, real people rather than contact databases.

title: About us
lead: We close the gap between Italian manufacturing and the Belarusian market.
story: Vikoma Group grew out of a simple observation: Italian manufacturers want to work with Belarus but don’t understand how that market works. And Belarusian companies want European quality but get lost in the search and the negotiations.
We close that gap. We know both sides — we speak both languages, we work within both regulatory systems, and we deal with real people rather than contact databases.
We don’t sell goods and we don’t take a cut of turnover. What we deliver is a working relationship between two companies — one that outlasts our involvement.

items.title: We don’t sell goods
items.text: We have no warehouse and no stake in any single shipment. We have no reason to push a partner on you — only a reason to make the relationship work.

items.title: We vet before we introduce
items.text: A counterparty’s legal and financial standing is checked before you spend time on a meeting.

items.title: Two languages, two legal systems
items.text: Correspondence, contracts and negotiations run without an interpreter in the middle. Both sides read the terms the same way.

items.title: We stay after the deal
items.text: The first delivery isn’t the finish line. We monitor how the distributor performs and remain available afterwards.
